reading.title: Medication Handoff Card — share a clear medicine list
h1s: Make a clear medication handoff card.
reading.mainText:
A DATED LIST FOR THE NEXT HANDOFF

Make a clear medication handoff card.

For adult children, caregivers, and older adults sharing a checked list with family or clinicians.

Try it with sample data
See a completed card for Evelyn Parker.

Records stay in this browser.
Works offline after the first visit.
Card, print, and JSON backup are free; encrypted backups cost $12 once.
Communication tool, not medical advice.
No interaction checks or dose recommendations. Confirm every change with a qualified clinician or pharmacist.

CARD OWNER

Whose medicines are these?
Person’s name *
Person keeping this card
You, a relative, or the card owner
Save names

CURRENT LIST · 0

Medicines being taken

START WITH THE CURRENT LIST

No medicines on this card yet

Add exactly what is written on the label. This tool records what you enter; it does not check whether a medicine or dose is right.

Add first medicine

CHANGE HISTORY

What changed

Changes will appear here automatically when you add, edit, or stop a medicine.

THREE STEPS

How it works
Record the list.
Copy each medicine, dose, timing, and prescriber from a trusted source.
Check the handoff.
Confirm the current list and keep dated changes.
Share a copy.
Print one page or download a JSON backup.

PRIVACY

Your record stays on this device

There is no health-data account or cloud copy. You choose when to print or download a backup.

Read the privacy details

OPTIONAL · $12 ONCE

Protect backups with a passphrase

Encrypted backup is the only paid feature. The card, print view, and plain JSON backup are free.

Buy encrypted backups — $12
